name: Leon Edwards

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (74 in height, 74 in reach); 170 lb at the UFC 322 weigh-in (Nov 2025)

photo_coverage: Good. ESPN headshot and stance-left were uploaded during UFC 322 week (Nov 2025). Two profiles (Mar 2025, Nov 2025), a recent flash-lit frontal and a warm-light three-quarter. One freely licensed photo (Commons, 2021). A Commons file 'Leon Edwards UFC BELT 2023.png' (CC BY-SA 4.0) was left out: it looks like an official UFC promo cutout uploaded as 'own work', so its licence is doubtful. No 2026 photo was found; his last listed fight is UFC 322 (2025-11-15).

face.shape: Long oval, lean. Narrower than it is long, tapering through a beard-covered jaw to a moderately narrow chin.
face.jaw: Moderately wide, softened and squared off by the beard. In profile (03, 04) the jaw line is clean and slopes gently to the chin.
face.chin: Medium width, slightly long, moderate projection, under the beard
face.cheekbones: High and well defined; the cheeks below are lean/hollow
face.forehead: High, made to look higher by the receding temples; smooth and rounded

eyes.shape: Almond to slightly round, medium size, with a calm, slightly heavy-lidded look

eyebrows.shape: Gently arched, tapering at the outer ends

nose.tip: Rounded, moderately broad, with medium-wide nostrils

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; full lips with a full lower lip. Neutral at rest; wide smile with even teeth (Commons 2021).

ears.note: Sit slightly out from the head

face.notable_marks_scars: No obvious facial scars. A few small dark spots on the cheeks and forehead (cagesidepress photo). The reddish mark on the upper right chest below the collarbone is a tattoo (a red lip-print), not a scar; see tattoos.

hair.style: Very short buzz cut, even all over
hair.colour_note: Black. The buzz is short enough that scalp skin shows through, so render it as a dark tint over skin rather than strands.
hair.hairline: Receded at the temples into a rounded M; the front centre sits at roughly the normal height
hair.texture: Tightly coiled (visible as a dense, even buzz)

facial_hair.detail: Dense full beard about 1 to 2 cm long, joined to the moustache, trimmed to a clean, fairly high cheek line and a neat neck line under the jaw
facial_hair.colour_note: Black (jaw sample #2b1917). No visible grey as of Nov 2025.
facial_hair.shape: boxed full beard following the jaw, slightly fuller at the chin

skin.tone_hex_method: average of the eight cheek samples from five photos (forehead samples sit on specular highlights and are excluded); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch

tone_samples.where: cheek below cheekbone, right side (box x1100-1200, y280-360 of 1920x1080)
cheek below cheekbone, image-left side (box x300-380, y650-760 of 1247x1673)

skin.freckles_marks: Small dark spots on the cheeks and forehead. No freckles.
skin.note: The ESPN grade is very warm (cheek samples #bf512e and #db633d, re-checked in review as #c1522e and #d55f39), the flash photo is lifted, and the 2021 Commons still has a cool cast (#6d5155). Review added the 03 and 07 cheek samples, which moves the average from #c4724b to the value above. Medium-dark brown with a warm undertone; he reads lighter and warmer than Kamaru Usman in comparable studio light (ESPN cheek #c1522e vs #7c442f).

body.build: Long-limbed, lean, athletic welterweight (188 cm, 77 kg)
body.body_fat_note: Abs visible in both ESPN cutouts
body.shoulders: Moderately broad and squared, with defined deltoids
body.chest: Flat, well-defined pectorals of medium thickness
body.arms: Long and lean, with defined biceps and forearms
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs; slim calves
body.notable: Long neck and long limbs relative to his frame. He looks taller and slimmer than Usman.

tattoos.where: upper left chest / left pectoral below the collarbone
tattoos.description: Cursive script 'Death Before Dishonour' in two lines

tattoos.where: upper right chest below the collarbone
tattoos.description: Two lines of thin cursive script, roughly 'God protect me from my friends / I'll take care of my enemies', running diagonally across the upper right chest toward the shoulder

tattoos.where: upper right chest near the collarbone, above the script
tattoos.description: A small red lip-print (kiss) tattoo, the only colour tattoo; it reads as a reddish mark at low resolution
Black-and-grey portrait of a veiled, weeping Virgin Mary with eyes closed and hands pressed together in prayer, about from the collarbone script down to the nipple
The name EDWARDS in large Old English/gothic capitals running vertically down the ribs, from below the pec toward the waistband
Dense black-and-grey forearm piece from the elbow toward the wrist (individual motifs not readable at the available resolution)

kit.fight_shorts: 2025 (ESPN UFC 322-era cutout): black UFC shorts with a grey layered-scale pattern, a black-and-white checker waistband and crypto.com logo; red Venum shorts (2022 cutout); black with gold trim as champion (2023-2024)
kit.walkout: Black Venum hoodie with gold UFC lettering (champion era)

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: No hairline-recession or beard-shape targets: do these in the hair/beard textures. No ear targets in the shipped manifest (a small forward rotation is under morphs_if_available).
notes: Confidence: medium-high for the overall look (long oval face, receding buzz cut, dense boxed black beard, high cheekbones, long lean frame, chest scripts); medium for morph values. What to watch for: (1) the receding temple hairline is important for the likeness and must be in the scalp texture; (2) the beard is dense and neatly edged, so do not render stubble; (3) keep him slimmer and longer-limbed than Usman; (4) no 2026 photos were found (data/derived/fighters.json lists his last fight as UFC 322 on 2025-11-15), so the Nov 2025 photos are the most current; (5) macro/heightUpM uses a linear fit to the two MPFB2 builds in research/assets.md (height slider 0.30 -> 1.61 m, 0.62 -> 1.89 m, so slider = 0.5 + (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 and heightUpM = 2 * (slider - 0.5)). Muscle and weight also change stature slightly, so measure the built mesh and nudge heightUpM until it matches the listed height. Review (second pass, 2026-11-06): re-checked every photo. Corrected the tattoos: the 'reddish mark' on the upper right chest is a red lip-print tattoo, the right-pec figure is a praying, weeping Virgin Mary, the right-chest script is legible, and the left-rib letters spell EDWARDS. Skin average updated with two more cheek samples. Commons licence for Leon_Edwards_2021.png re-checked (CC BY 3.0, James English). A web search found no 2026 fight photos. Morph names and ranges validated against assets/embed/mh-manifest.json; values unchanged.
